t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are two groups of gnomes: a) 'pink, purple, brown and red', and b) 'blue, orange, yellow and green'. one group will be worth more than the other, but this can swap throughout the game. once you think you know which group is higher scoring, stick with that group until you notice a change, then swap to the other group. at some point, both groups may be low scoring and you will need to keep swapping between the 2 until you notice one has become higher again.

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 groups of Gnomes:a) Blue, Green, Yellow and Orangeb) Pink, Red, Purple and BrownEach of these groups can be either high or low in value. This can change randomly throughout the game. Once you think you've figured out which is the highest scoring group, stick with it until you notice a change. Sometimes both groups will be scoring low, so you will need to keep swapping between the 2 until one becomes high value.
